# Real Estate MCP connectors

2 real estate connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All real estate connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/real-estate](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/real-estate).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ImmobilienScout24 API](connectors/immobilienscout24.md) | Search real estate listings on ImmobilienScout24, Germany's largest property portal, from any AI assistant. | 3 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/immobilienscout24-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-immobilienscout24-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-immobilienscout24-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-immobilienscout24-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-immobilienscout24-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-immobilienscout24-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-immobilienscout24-to-muse) |
| [Propstack](connectors/propstack.md) | Propstack — the CRM German estate agents run on: properties, contacts, enquiries, activities, projects and saved searches. | 8 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/propstack-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-propstack-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-propstack-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-propstack-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-propstack-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-propstack-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-propstack-to-muse) |
